verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a CLI for running API tests/monitoring from terminal (scriptable, could be cron-scheduled) and an MCP server allowing agents to read/modify collections, both verified hands-on. However, there is no evidence of a built-in scheduler, triggers, or persistent background job runner that autonomously executes automations without external orchestration (e.g., cron). Missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger system, evidence of autonomous background execution without relying on external cron/CI, and documentation of long-running or event-driven automation workflows.
